_comment: The harness size budget (Round 3 / W7, ADR-H288). The TOTAL is the binding constraint; the per-module ratchet lives in python/tests/test_size_budget.py. Raising a ceiling is allowed but must be a deliberate edit to this file - the point is that growth cannot happen silently. The V2 terminal merge removed the direct sandbox path (ADR-H311); reconciling origin/main's live-preflight and outage guards added 24 evaluation lines, so the committed ceiling is the measured merged tree. Re-pinned 2026-11-01 to the measured tree at the quant node-pack commit: the growth is the market-read nodes, signed webhooks + integration.http 1.1.0, broker/trading nodes + paper risk gate, kit ratio calculator and the bot-skill plan (python/harness/{.,code,routers,eclipse_memory,skills,evaluation}); graph_runtime/ has no per-directory ceiling. This is a checkpoint, not an allowance - the ratchet resumes from these numbers.
